turns.prompt_text: find me a free QR code generator
turns.response_html:
For a high-quality, free QR code generator that doesn't require a sign-up, QRCode Monkey is the top recommendation. It allows for full customization, including colors and logos, and produces high-resolution files (PNG, SVG, PDF) that never expire.

Top Recommendations

  • QRCode Monkey: Best for high-res printing and custom branding with logos.
  • Adobe Express: Quick, sleek, and reliable for simple static codes.
  • QR Creator: Great for vector data (SVG) and features a "print simulation" to ensure your code is scannable at its printed size.
  • Jotform: Best for a clean, professional interface with no account needed.

Pro-Tip for Browsers

If you just need a quick code for a website you're currently visiting:

  • Chrome/Edge: Right-click anywhere on the page and select Create QR Code for this page.

Would you like me to find a tool specifically for dynamic codes that you can edit later?
